notes: SPT-3G 2019 observing season data searching for axionlike time-dependent cosmic birefringence via polarization rotation of CMB photons. The paper sets limits on axion-photon coupling g_agamma over mass range ~10^-22 to 10^-19 eV (oscillation periods 12 hours to 100 days). For the flat region (periods 1-100 days, 4.7×10^-22 eV ≤ m_φ ≤ 4.7×10^-20 eV), median 95% C.L. limit is g_agamma < 1.18×10^-12 GeV^-1 × (m_φ / 1.0×10^-21 eV). The limit degrades at higher frequencies due to finite observation duration (~2 hours). Assumes local dark matter density ρ_0 = 0.3 GeV/cm³ and that axions comprise 100% of local dark matter. This represents ~3.8× improvement over previous BICEP/Keck 2022 limits using the same AC oscillation effect. Data extracted from Eq. (23) and surrounding text; additional points from Eq.
